name: @missing-elements/h5p-author
description: Builds a playable .h5p of any content type in the H5P hub's library pack from a short JSON source: only the fields that differ from the defaults, the rest filled from the libraries' own semantics and translations. For AI agents and scripts; no H5P server.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if (!/^pnpm\//.test(process.env.npm_config_user_agent || '')) { console.error('Publish with pnpm publish: npm would ship the workspace: dependency ranges as they are, and the package would not install.'); process.exit(1) }" && node scripts/check-pack-published.mjs && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.types: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('types', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json
